steps.name: Sharper Eyes Than an Owl? 🦉 Spot the Difference Challenge #shorts
steps.query:
mutation($input: CreatePostInput!) { createPost(input: $input) { __typename
  ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id dueAt status } } ... on MutationError { message } } }

input.text:
Owls have amazing eyes. Do you?
Can you spot all 6 differences before the timer runs out?

6 Spot the Difference puzzles: balls, toys, prizes, music, sports gear and clocks. 2 easy, 2 medium, 2 hard.

Comment your score out of 6 below!
Subscribe for a new puzzle every day: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCl870UQHJt9aZCNW-IhK1gA?sub_confirmation=1

ANSWERS (no peeking!)
1. (Easy) Square three! The football became a burger.
2. (Easy) Square one! The teddy bear became a dinosaur.
3. (Medium) Square four! The trophy turned into a vase.
4. (Medium) Square seven! The bell went silent.
5. (Hard) Square one! The paddle became a frying pan.
6. (Hard) Square five! That clock now says two o'clock.
